summary: Verified magic-link URL host derivation fix. New pytest suite (11/11) covers: default preview-host derivation via the public URL (proves the original cartrack-19.emergent.host bug is fixed), Host header fallback via loopback, X-Forwarded-Host and X-Forwarded-Proto honouring via loopback, all four endpoints (POST/GET /platform/tenants, POST /platform/tenants/{id}/magic-link, GET /platform/demo-tokens), end-to-end redeemability, and real-tenant regression. Prior magic-link regression suites also pass: 8/8 (test_demo_magic_link.py, 1 pre-existing skip) + 8/8 (test_demo_regenerate_and_list.py).
critical_code_review_comments: Note: K8s/CloudFront ingress overrides client-supplied X-Forwarded-Host with the real host before reaching the backend (confirmed by 403 + rewrite). Header-derivation therefore only helps for legitimate proxy chains (e.g., custom domain fronting the Emergent deployment) — for those, the code correctly picks up ingress-provided X-Forwarded-Host. Tests use loopback :8001 to prove the code path itself works.
server.py is 12k+ lines — should be split into focused modules (unchanged from previous iterations).

seed_data_creation: Tests create ~7 demo tenants + 1 real tenant with unique timestamp slugs; teardown removes them via DELETE /api/platform/tenants/{id}.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Host-derivation fix verified. New regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_demo_url_host_derivation.py — public-URL tests + internal-loopback tests for X-Forwarded-*. Kubernetes ingress strips/overrides client-supplied X-Forwarded-Host, so any future X-Forwarded-Host tests via public URL must use loopback :8001 instead.
